name: OneForma
work: Language and data projects: transcription, translation, audio and text annotation, search evaluation and UHRS tasks.

availability.note: OneForma publishes no country list we could find. A worker in Kenya was able to open an account, but has not yet been paid, so Kenya is not confirmed.

items.text: You must set up a payment method and upload a tax form before starting any paid work. Non-US residents use the W-8BEN form.
Three payout options: Payoneer (recommended, no cap, monthly), PayPal (only up to 300 US dollars a year) and Tipalti.
For UHRS jobs, Payoneer must be your default payment method, and one Payoneer account can only be linked to one OneForma user.
No invoice is generated in a month where you earn less than 10 US dollars. The balance carries over until it reaches that amount.
International transfers and currency exchange can add extra fees.
